premises.text: Many people are overweight or obese due to unhealthy eating habits.
premises.evidence_span: nearly 70% of us are overweight or obese

premises.text: Healthy eating can be achieved without calorie counting or restrictive diets.
premises.evidence_span: healthy eating doesn't necessarily mean calorie counting, juice cleanses, intermittent fasting

premises.text: Meal planning using high-quality restaurant food can promote healthy eating.
premises.evidence_span: we plan out your meals using high-quality restaurant food that can be delivered to your home and office

premises.text: Personalized meal recommendations can improve user satisfaction and adherence.
premises.evidence_span: he gets a personalized menu that's tailored to just him

premises.text: Users can modify their meal choices based on preferences and dietary needs.
premises.evidence_span: he can quickly cancel out of the meal... he can click edit, edit, and there are thousands of different dishes for him to choose from

premises.text: Using data to learn user preferences can enhance meal recommendations.
premises.evidence_span: we learn about his user preferences

premises.text: Healthy Out can deliver food quickly and in a visually appealing manner.
premises.evidence_span: hand-delivered to you within the hour

premises.text: Healthy Out's business model allows for high gross profit without holding inventory.
premises.evidence_span: That's virtually all gross profit. Not like those diet meal delivery guys. We don't hold inventory.

premises.text: The market for Healthy Out is large, especially in urban areas.
premises.evidence_span: the opportunity is so large that we can do that here in New York City alone

value.text: Consumers can access convenient, personalized, and healthy meal options.
value.evidence_span: it's convenient, it's no hassle healthy, and it's seriously delicious food

notes: Traction metrics and fundraising details excluded as they do not support premises.
